purpose: U3 one-command regeneration: parameter change -> full regen. Data, not code: flow_graph/param/regen.py executes these stages topologically (manifest order must be a valid topological order; flow_graph/param/test_regen.py enforces it). Graph-writing stages (writes_graph true) run as a successive-substitution loop until the graph sha is stable, then every doc stage runs once against the final graph so its sidecar/manifest graph sha matches (U2a mechanism).
notes: CORRECTION vs the U3 audit order (verified against code 2026-10-18, commit 0847940): _load_list/_one_line moved AFTER the graph writers. U1 (A-M-231) made _power_sizing.py graph-native (it no longer reads the load list), and the U2a sidecars (LOAD_LIST.json/ONE_LINE.json) record the graph sha at run time, so both must run after the last graph write or they vouch an intermediate sha.
CORRECTION: foundry_poly --write runs BEFORE write_graph heat (it stamps FOUNDRY/POLYMERS rates; heat re-solves the ladder against them) and before the balance report.

CORRECTION: balance runs REPORT-ONLY (no --write). The --write assert (max unit residual < 1e-3 kg/d) is red at HEAD: the NORTH_DOCK ledger residual 5.5478 kg/d is reported, not force-closed (A-M-254; known-red test_balance trio). The stage still regenerates BALANCE_RECONCILIATION.md. Restore --write when the balance lane closes closure.
CORRECTION: _rect_ew_sizing.py is NOT a stage: it writes no doc (stdout JSON only) and is spawned internally by _power_sizing.py, _one_line.py and write_graph.process.

CORRECTION: write_graph power runs LAST among graph writers: _power_sizing demand = max(node continuous_kw, SOL_ARK feed) over every stamp written by the sizing modules, and power then re-stamps PV/ZNBR2/EXT_HALL/mvs.electrical + runs _collection_bus (itself a graph writer).

DECLARED-DAG NOTE: power -> pv_cell_line is a real feedback edge (PV array size sets the cell-line duty; the cell-line kW enters the demand). The manifest declares pv_cell_line -> power only so the dependency graph stays a DAG; regen.py resolves the cycle by looping the writes_graph block to its fixed point (observed: <= 3 passes from a drifted tree, 1 pass from a converged tree).

EXCLUDED (by design, with reason): flow_graph/param/sanitation.py --write (X-SAN-01 graph-writer; owner-lane port pending, R11 close-out; sizing/SANITATION.md stays classified by-design in _rev_stamp); flow_graph/param/o2_source.py (main is the frozen Rev A study over git-show 6537017; O2_SOURCE.md classified by-design); _mfg_tools --graph and _material_temps --write and _resize_sweep.py (one-shot stampers; their doc/report halves are covered where spawned); pressure_nodes.py (one-shot Rev A pressurised-node marker, superseded by write_graph relief).

--quick = the five write_graph stages only (solver + writer what-if mode): no doc regeneration and NO receipt write (a partial run must not clobber the full-run provenance receipt _rev_stamp vouches from).
